description: List the degrees taught at a high school, with their ids, so you can pass degree_id to search-courses. The ids are national, so search-courses can use them with no school. Pass institution_id from search-institutions. A university id is not a high school. Each degree may include grades with grade ids. When grades are not listed, take grade_id from a search-courses result. Show the user the degree and grade names, not the ids.

institution_id.description: Numeric high-school id from search-institutions (the id field). Example: 42. A university id does not list degrees.

name: list-degrees
title: List Degrees
